name: Stacked rice sheets
summary: One hot rice sheet on its own plate. You add the grill and the pickle, roll it, and stack the empty plates. Sauce lists do not match. The price now is Check on arrival.
origin: Vietnam National Administration of Tourism calls bánh ướt chồng đĩa a Buon Ma Thuot specialty, served one sheet to a plate.
howToEat: Vietnam National Administration of Tourism says each plate is one ultra-thin hot sheet, sprinkled with scallion fat, chives, and dried-shrimp powder. The side plate holds grilled minced pork, grilled pork, fermented pork, silk sausage, cinnamon sausage, pickled vegetables, shredded mango, cucumber, and Thai basil. You roll it. The sauce is mắm nêm or a sweet-sour fish sauce. The article says people eat 10 to 20 plates, sometimes more than 30, and stack the plates. It prints no price.

VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 names grilled pork, silk sausage, mango, and pickled vegetables, and two sauces: mắm nêm or mắm mặn. It prints 25,000 VND for the meat and sausage, plus 1,000 VND for each sheet.

VnExpress on 21 Feb 2016 says the sheet is rice flour from ordinary rice, ground wet, with a few seasonings, cooked when someone orders. The sides are grilled pork, mango, pickles, cucumber, and herbs. The sauce is mắm nêm or a sweet-sour fish sauce. It prints about 30,000–50,000 VND a person. The price now is Check on arrival.
where: VnExpress names Trần Nhật Duật on 21 Feb 2016, and Trần Nhật Duật and Lê Thánh Tông on 27 Mar 2021. A stall number is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
